verdict.rationale: The firm publishes at least one public insight on its own site about founder equity: a piece on BSPCE (French founder share warrant) taxation under the 2026 finance law, listed on the Executives & Management Packages page. This is a thin, glancing match. The rest of the pack is service-marketing practice pages, not plain-language guides or FAQs. Missing for 10: any structured startup knowledge base or resource hub; plain-language guides or FAQs on company formation; explainers on financing rounds; evidence that the content is founder-oriented rather than technical client alerts; English-language startup content; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
